text: Linear algebra is the branch of mathematics concerning linear equations, vectors and matrices. A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers. Vectors and matrices are the foundation of machine learning representations, allowing data to be expressed in a form that gradient-based algorithms can operate on.

LoRA, or Low-Rank Adaptation, is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. It freezes the pretrained weight matrices and injects trainable low-rank decomposition matrices, reducing the number of trainable parameters by orders of magnitude while matching full fine-tuning performance.

The Adam optimizer extends stochastic gradient descent with adaptive estimates of the first and second moment of the gradient. It maintains a running average of the gradient and its square, adapting the learning rate per parameter.

Retrieval-augmented generation combines a parametric sequence-to-sequence model with a non-parametric retriever. The retriever fetches relevant documents from an index and the generator conditions on them, reducing hallucination and allowing knowledge updates without retraining.

The Transformer architecture dispenses with recurrence and convolution entirely, relying only on attention mechanisms. Self-attention allows each position in a sequence to attend to all positions, enabling parallel training and modelling long-range dependencies.

Graph neural networks generalize convolutional neural networks to irregular domains by aggregating information from a node's neighbourhood according to the graph structure, learning node representations that encode both local topology and feature information.

Probability theory provides the mathematical language for modelling uncertainty and randomness in data. A probability distribution assigns a probability to each outcome of a random experiment, and expectation gives the long-run average value of a random variable.

Low-Rank Adaptation injects trainable low-rank matrices into a frozen pretrained model. Because only the low-rank factors are trained, the number of updated parameters is far smaller than full fine-tuning while the base weights stay frozen.
